author: allnes
title: NPU Models Tests - TensorFlow compile-only convert_model step fails on Windows runner
signature: tf models tests npu compile only convert model step failed|Flaky Test
key_errors: TensorFlow Models Tests - NPU compile-only (convert_model) step failed (all three NPU platform variants: 3720, 4000, 5020)
root_cause: The 'TensorFlow Models Tests - NPU compile-only (convert_model)' step failed on all three NPU runners. This is a known flaky pattern (signature hash 2abe56c58c994e45, occurrence 3) that has been observed since 2026-08-19 on Windows NPU test runners. The failure is unrelated to the GPU-focused PR #37559 (SelectiveSSM JIT kernels). The PyTorch model hub tests (run after the TF tests in the same job) passed successfully with 4 passed/7 skipped. The TF convert_model failure appears to be a transient infrastructure issue on the Windows NPU test runners.
reproduction_steps: Run TensorFlow Models Tests NPU compile-only (convert_model) on Windows NPU runner platforms 3720, 4000, 5020.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs to confirm the transient nature of the failure.
Investigate if a specific TF model or conversion step is intermittently failing.
Consider adding retry logic to the TF NPU compile-only test step.
prevention_strategies: This is a recurring flaky test pattern on Windows NPU runners. Consider adding retry logic for the TF convert_model step or investigating root cause of intermittent failures.
historical_context: This same pattern has been observed 3 times total since 2026-08-19: runs 32266833204, 32797618628, and now 32925478375. Affects multiple unrelated PRs, confirming it is infrastructure/test-side flakiness.
